comment: Independent blessed potion.c:peffect_restore_ability witness for the full attribute loop. The debug Monk raises to level 5, loses down to level 2, then quaffs the blessed potion. C wiz_level_change resets u.ulevelmax to the current level after lowering, so this recipe does not enter potion.c's potion-only pluslvl(FALSE) lost-level branch; that branch remains explicitly uncovered.
